findings.title: Cook County Health and Hospitals System terminates relationship with medical transcription service, notifying patients of breach
findings.summary_md: Cook County Health and Hospitals System terminated its relationship with medical transcription vendor Perry Johnson & Associates and notified patients after PJ&A reported a data security incident. CCH said PJ&A informed it on July 21, 2023 that an unauthorized individual had accessed its systems in April 2023, and CCH was notified on July 26 that patient information might be affected. The notice says 1.2 million CCH patients were impacted. This is the earliest public reporting found in this search, about three weeks before PJ&A filed with HHS.

findings.title: New York's Largest Health System Affected by PJ&A Data Breach
findings.summary_md: HIPAA Journal reported that Northwell Health, New York's largest health system, was notified by PJ&A on July 21, 2023 about a cyberattack that ran from March 27 to May 2, 2023. Northwell initially drafted a statement saying 3,891,565 individuals were affected, then recalled it and said it could not confirm the exact number. PJ&A completed its initial investigation on September 28, 2023, and the exposed data included names, addresses, dates of birth, diagnoses, test results, and some Social Security numbers.

findings.title: 9 million patients had data stolen after US medical transcription firm hacked
findings.summary_md: TechCrunch reported that PJ&A told the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services more than 8.95 million individuals were affected by a breach that began as early as March 2023, and that the company began notifying patients on October 31. The stolen data included names, dates of birth, addresses, medical record and hospital account numbers, admission diagnoses, dates and times of service, and some Social Security numbers, insurance, and clinical information. Northwell Health confirmed 3.89 million patients affected and Cook County Health confirmed 1.2 million, including 2,600 records containing Social Security numbers.

findings.title: PJ&A says cyberattack exposed data of nearly 9 million patients
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer reported that PJ&A said a March 2023 cyberattack exposed the personal information of almost nine million patients, with threat actor access between March 27 and May 2, 2023. The HHS Office for Civil Rights breach portal confirms the number as 8,952,212 patients. PJ&A began sending breach notices on October 31, 2023, and Northwell Health said its data was stolen between April 7 and April 19.

findings.title: Medical Transcriber's Hack Breach Affects at Least 9 Million
findings.summary_md: BankInfoSecurity reported that PJ&A's breach report, filed November 3 with the HHS Office for Civil Rights, said the hacking incident affected more than 8.95 million people. Northwell Health disclosed that nearly 3.9 million of its patients were affected, and Cook County Health reported 1.2 million patients impacted. The article notes Cook County Health had reported the incident to HHS OCR on September 24 with a placeholder estimate of only 500 individuals.

findings.title: Attorney General James Warns New Yorkers Impacted by Medical Company's Data Breach of Potential Identity Theft
findings.summary_md: New York Attorney General Letitia James warned New Yorkers affected by the PJ&A breach to monitor their credit and consider freezes or fraud alerts. The AG said the breach affected nearly nine million patients, including approximately four million New Yorkers in New York City and Syracuse, and that Northwell Health and Crouse Health were affected. The AG said PJ&A became aware of the breach in May 2023 and that the data included some Social Security numbers, insurance, and clinical information.

findings.title: Hack of PJ&A tops 2023 US healthcare data breaches as tally jumps by 4M
findings.summary_md: SC Media reported that Concentra Health Services notified HHS that 3,998,162 of its patients were affected, bringing the total number of patients impacted by the PJ&A breach to over 14 million and making it the largest U.S. health sector breach of 2023. The attackers had access between March 27 and May 2, 2023 and exfiltrated data from April 7 to April 9. Cook County Health reported 1.2 million patients affected and Northwell Health initially said 3.9 million.

findings.title: Concentra Confirms Almost 4 Million Patients Affected by PJ&A Data Breach
findings.summary_md: HIPAA Journal reported that Concentra confirmed on January 9, 2024 that 3,998,162 patients were affected, bringing the total to at least 14 million and making the PJ&A breach the largest healthcare data breach of 2023. At least 40 lawsuits had been filed against PJ&A and affected clients. North Kansas City Hospital and its subsidiary Meritas Health reported 502,438 individuals affected between March 27 and May 2, 2023.

findings.title: Federal criminal investigation involving Perry Johnson & Associates data breach
findings.summary_md: DataBreaches.Net reported that WBEZ obtained records showing a federal criminal investigation into the PJ&A breach, including a grand jury subpoena sent to Cook County Health in November seeking all information related to the incident. The subpoena was signed by Acting U.S. Attorney Morris Pasqual and a prosecutor in the Justice Department's Fraud Section, and sought PJ&A's contract with Cook County, due-diligence records, and communications about the leak. WBEZ reported the breach potentially affected 1.2 million Cook County patients and 14 million people across the country.
